actions.description: Copy a file or folder to a different location in the user's Dropbox. If the source path is a folder all its contents will be copied.

actions.name: Copy Files Or Folders
actions.description: Copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in the user's Dropbox. This action will either finish synchronously, or return a job ID and do the async copy job in background. Please use "Copy Files Or Folders" action to check the job status.

actions.name: Copy Files Or Folders Status

actions.name: Create Folder
actions.description: Create a folder at a given path.

actions.name: Create Folders
actions.description: Create multiple folders at once. This route is asynchronous for large batches, which returns a job ID immediately and runs the create folder batch asynchronously. Otherwise, creates the folders and returns the result synchronously for smaller inputs. You can force asynchronous behaviour by using the CreateFolderBatchArg.force_async flag.

actions.name: Create Folders Status
actions.description: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for "Create Folders" action. If success, it returns list of result for each entry.

actions.name: Delete File Or Folder
actions.description: Delete the file or folder at a given path. If the path is a folder, all its contents will be deleted too. A successful response indicates that the file or folder was deleted. The returned metadata will be the corresponding FileMetadata or FolderMetadata for the item at time of deletion, and not a DeletedMetadata object.

actions.name: Delete Files Or Folders
actions.description: Delete multiple files/folders at once. This route is asynchronous, which returns a job ID immediately and runs the delete batch asynchronously. Use "Delete Files Or Folders Status" action to check the job status.

actions.name: Delete Files Or Folders Status
actions.description: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for delete_batch. If success, it returns list of result for each entry.

actions.name: Download Folder As ZIP

The resulting zip must have fewer than 10,000 total file and folder entries, including the top level folder. The input cannot be a single file.

actions.description: Closes the incident, moving it to the closed milestone. Typically used after the incident is resolved and its retrospective is done.

actions.name: Create Incident
actions.description: Declares a new incident. Only name is required; remove the fields you don't use. severity and priority take the slug from List Severities / List Priorities. impacts is a JSON array of impacted environments or services, each {"type": "environment"|"service"|"functionality", "id": "<id>", "condition_id": "<id from List Severity Matrix Conditions>"}. team_ids is a JSON array of team IDs from List...

actions.name: Get Incident
actions.description: Retrieves a single incident by ID, including its current milestone, severity, priority, impacts and assigned teams.

actions.name: List Environments
actions.description: Lists environments. Use an environment id in the impacts of Create Incident or Update Incident Impact And Milestone. query searches by name or description; remove it if unused. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Incident Roles
actions.description: Lists incident roles (for example Incident Commander). Use the id as incident_role_id in Assign Role To Incident. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Incidents
actions.description: Lists incidents in the organization. Remove filters you don't use. query searches name, summary and description; severities, priorities, current_milestones, tags, teams, environments and services take comma-separated values; date filters take ISO8601 timestamps. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Lifecycle Phases
actions.description: Lists the lifecycle phases and the milestones in each. Milestone slugs are the values accepted by Update Incident Impact And Milestone and Resolve Incident, and by the current_milestones filter of List Incidents.

actions.name: List Priorities
actions.description: Lists the priorities configured in the organization. Use the slug as the priority value in Create Incident and Update Incident.

actions.name: List Services
actions.description: Lists services. Use a service id in the impacts of Create Incident or Update Incident Impact And Milestone. query searches by name or description; remove it if unused. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Severities
actions.description: Lists the severities configured in the organization. Use the slug as the severity value in Create Incident and Update Incident. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Severity Matrix Conditions
actions.description: Lists the impact conditions of the severity matrix (for example Unavailable, Partially Unavailable, Degraded). Each impact on an incident needs a condition_id from this list.

actions.name: List Teams
actions.description: Lists teams. Use a team id in team_ids of Create Incident or in Assign Team To Incident. query searches by name or description; remove it if unused. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: List Users
actions.description: Lists users in the organization. Use the id as user_id in Assign Role To Incident. query filters by name or email; remove it if unused. Paginated with page and per_page (default 20, max 200); the response carries data and pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

actions.name: Resolve Incident
actions.description: Resolves an active incident. milestone is optional: the slug of a post-incident or closed phase milestone from List Lifecycle Phases; remove it to use the default resolved milestone. Use Close Incident to close it fully.

actions.name: Update Incident
actions.description: Updates incident fields such as name, summary, description, severity and priority. Only the fields sent are changed; remove the ones you don't use. This endpoint does not change the milestone, impacts or assignments: use Update Incident Impact And Milestone, Resolve Incident, Assign Team To Incident or Assign Role To Incident.

actions.name: Update Incident Impact And Milestone
actions.description: Moves the incident to another milestone (status), adds or updates impacted environments/services, and optionally posts a note to the timeline in one call. All fields are optional; remove the ones you don't use. milestone is a milestone slug from List Lifecycle Phases (e.g. started, detected, acknowledged, mitigated, resolved). impact is a JSON array of {"id": "<environment or service id>"...

actions.name: Add Firewall Policy
actions.description: Create a new firewall policy on the FortiGate device. This action allows you to define source/destination interfaces, addresses, services, and actions (accept/deny).

actions.name: Add FQDN Address Object
actions.description: Create a new FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name) address object on the FortiGate device. An FQDN address object resolves a specific domain name to its IP addresses.

actions.name: Add IP Range Address Object
actions.description: Create a new IP range address object on the FortiGate device. An IP range address object defines a continuous range of IP addresses from a start IP to an end IP.

actions.name: Add MAC Address Object
actions.description: Create a new MAC Address object on the FortiGate device. A MAC Address object identifies devices by their hardware MAC address (e.g., 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E).

actions.name: Add Static Route
actions.description: Create a new static route on the FortiGate device. This action allows you to specify destination network, gateway, outgoing interface, and other routing parameters.

actions.name: Add Subnet Address Object
actions.description: Create a new subnet address object on the FortiGate device. A subnet address object defines a network with a specific subnet mask (e.g., 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0).

actions.name: Create Address Group
actions.description: Create a new address group on the FortiGate device. Address groups allow you to group multiple address objects together for use in firewall policies.

actions.name: Create System Backup
actions.description: Create a system configuration backup from the FortiGate device. This action returns the configuration file that can be used for backup and restore operations.

actions.name: Create User Account
actions.description: Create a new local user account on the FortiGate device. This action allows you to specify the username, password, and other account settings.

actions.name: Delete Address Object
actions.description: Delete an existing address object from the FortiGate device using the address object name.

actions.name: Delete Firewall Policy
actions.description: Delete an existing firewall policy on the FortiGate device using the policy ID.

actions.name: Delete Static Route
actions.description: Delete a static route from the FortiGate device using the route ID. The route ID can be obtained from the Get Static Routes action.

actions.name: Delete User Account
actions.description: Delete a local user account from the FortiGate device. This action removes the specified user account completely.

actions.name: Get Disk Event System Logs
actions.description: Retrieve system event logs from disk storage on the FortiGate device. These logs contain historical information about system-related events and activities.

actions.name: Get Disk Traffic Forward Logs
actions.description: Retrieve forward traffic logs from disk storage on the FortiGate device. These logs contain historical information about traffic passing through the device.

actions.name: Get Disk Traffic Local Logs
actions.description: Retrieve local traffic logs from disk storage on the FortiGate device. These logs contain historical information about traffic to the device itself.

actions.name: Get Disk Traffic Sniffer Logs
actions.description: Retrieve sniffer traffic logs from disk storage on the FortiGate device. These logs contain historical information about traffic captured by the sniffer feature.

actions.name: Get DNS Settings
actions.description: Retrieve DNS settings from the FortiGate device. This action returns information about configured DNS servers, domain search lists, and DNS cache settings.

actions.name: Get Firewall Policies
actions.description: Retrieve all firewall policies configured on the FortiGate device.

actions.name: Get FortiAnalyzer Event System Logs
actions.description: Retrieve system event logs from the connected FortiAnalyzer. These logs contain information about system-related events and activities that have been forwarded to FortiAnalyzer for storage and analysis.

actions.name: Get FortiAnalyzer Traffic Forward Logs
actions.description: Retrieve forward traffic logs from the connected FortiAnalyzer. These logs contain information about traffic passing through the FortiGate device that has been forwarded to FortiAnalyzer for storage and analysis.

actions.name: Get FortiAnalyzer Traffic Local Logs
actions.description: Retrieve local traffic logs from the connected FortiAnalyzer. These logs contain information about traffic to the FortiGate device itself that has been forwarded to FortiAnalyzer for storage and analysis.

actions.name: Get FortiAnalyzer Traffic Sniffer Logs
actions.description: Retrieve sniffer traffic logs from the connected FortiAnalyzer. These logs contain information about traffic captured by the sniffer feature that has been forwarded to FortiAnalyzer for storage and analysis.

actions.name: Get License Information
actions.description: Retrieve license information from the FortiGate device including status, expiration dates, and features for various services like FortiGuard, FortiCare, and other subscriptions.

actions.name: Get Memory Event System Logs
actions.description: Retrieve system event logs from memory on the FortiGate device. These logs contain information about system-related events and activities.

actions.name: Get Memory Traffic Forward Logs
actions.description: Retrieve forward traffic logs from memory on the FortiGate device. These logs contain information about traffic passing through the device.

actions.name: Get Memory Traffic Local Logs
actions.description: Retrieve local traffic logs from memory on the FortiGate device. These logs contain information about traffic to the device itself.

actions.name: Get Memory Traffic Sniffer Logs
actions.description: Retrieve sniffer traffic logs from memory on the FortiGate device. These logs contain information about traffic captured by the sniffer feature.

actions.name: Get Network Interfaces
actions.description: Retrieve information about network interfaces on the FortiGate device including interface names, IP addresses, status, and configuration details.

actions.name: Get Resource Usage
actions.description: Retrieve resource usage statistics from the FortiGate device including CPU, memory, and disk usage. Useful for monitoring device performance and capacity planning.

actions.name: Get SSL VPN Settings
actions.description: Retrieve SSL VPN settings from the FortiGate device. This includes configuration details for SSL VPN portals, authentication methods, and access rules.

actions.name: Get Static Routes
actions.description: Retrieve static routing information from the FortiGate device. This action returns all configured static routes including destination networks, gateways, and interfaces.

actions.name: Get System Information
actions.description: Retrieve system information from the FortiGate device including version, serial number, hostname, and other details.

actions.name: Get User Accounts
actions.description: Retrieve information about local user accounts configured on the FortiGate device. This includes usernames, status, and authentication settings (passwords not included for security reasons).

actions.name: Get VPN Tunnels
actions.description: Retrieve all IPsec VPN tunnels (phase1 interfaces) configured on the FortiGate device.

actions.name: Monitor VPN Status
actions.description: Monitor the status of IPsec VPN tunnels on the FortiGate device. This action returns real-time information about tunnel status, traffic, and other operational metrics.

actions.name: Update Firewall Policy
actions.description: Update an existing firewall policy on the FortiGate device. This action allows you to modify source/destination interfaces, addresses, services, and actions (accept/deny) for a policy identified by its ID.

actions.name: Update Static Route
actions.description: Update an existing static route on the FortiGate device. This action allows you to modify the destination network, gateway, output interface, and other routing parameters for a specific route identified by its ID.

Add the optional URL parameters start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD or epoch), status (OPEN, CLOSED, ON_HOLD) or severities (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) to filter. company_id is your SOCRadar company ID.

actions.name: Get IOC Enrichment
actions.description: Returns SOCRadar IOC Enrichment details for an indicator (file hash, IP, domain or URL): risk score, malware categorization, whitelist status and the key's remaining daily credit. Requires an IOC Enrichment API key. The first query for an indicator SOCRadar does not hold yet returns HTTP 404 ('Indicator doesn't exist.') and starts a lookup; a repeated query returns the result, so 404 is retried...

actions.name: Get Rapid Reputation
actions.description: Returns a fast reputation verdict for an indicator from the SOCRadar Rapid Reputation API: a 0-100 score (higher is worse) and whitelist status under body.data, plus the key's remaining daily credit under body.data.credit_details. Requires a Rapid Reputation API key. Both entity_value and entity_type (ip, hostname, url or hash) are required; a missing entity_value returns HTTP 200 with...

actions.name: Get Threat Analysis Result
actions.description: Returns the result of a triggered SOCRadar threat analysis by its analysis UID: trust score, threat findings, risk impact and enrichment fields. Requires the pay-per-use Threat Analysis API key.

actions.name: Get Threat Feed Collection
actions.description: Lists every indicator in a subscribed SOCRadar threat feed collection, as a JSON array whose items expose feed (the indicator value) and feed_type. Requires a Threat Feed API key on a connection that passes it as the URL parameter key. A collection is single-typed (hash, ip, hostname or url) and refreshes about once a day.

actions.name: List Threat Actors
actions.description: Lists SOCRadar threat actor groups of one type (malware_group, apt_group or ransomware_group). Add the optional URL parameters target_sector, target_country, used_cve, used_malware or suspected_state_sponsor to filter.

actions.name: Remove Entities from Allowlist

actions.name: Search Info Stealer Logs
actions.description: Searches SOCRadar's info stealer logs for exposed credentials. query_type is domain, email, username or url; log_start_date and log_end_date are YYYY-MM-DD. Use it to check whether a user or host from a SentinelOne alert appears in stealer logs. Results page with offset.
